units: stage px, origin top-left, y down; stage 1920x1080 = the 1920x1080 Game view. RectTransform: anchorMin = (x/W, 1-(y+h)/H), anchorMax = ((x+w)/W, 1-y/H) on a stage-sized root. ppu = sprite px per 100 stage px x 100 (100 = 1x, 200 = 2x).
groups: ui (#ui DOM: chrome, media; text = Unity Text)
blendNote: blend = the canvas op inside its group: 'alpha' source-over, 'additive' plus-lighter. In the browser an additive op adds onto the group's own pixels and is source-over onto what lies under the group, so an additive layer is pure add over an opaque layer of its group (the Stone) and premultiplied over elsewhere; check.py measures both Unity choices per layer (out/check/E7_report.json 'unity').
